answer: Each identity binds one provider-signed training voyage: a model trained at least 40 GPU-hours on 10,000 records, plus a 30 POA bond locked 90 days. The Meadow verifier checks signature, dataset hash, and GPU-hours on-chain; a reused receipt slashes both bonds. Each extra fake needs a dataset unlike all earlier ones, so curation cost climbs per fake: 100 fakes need 4,000 GPU-hours and 3,000 POA locked. Each epoch the model passes a pulse check, answering a fresh nonce prompt in 10 minutes; two misses freeze payouts. Public datasets can collide, so a flagged identity gets one 7-day appeal.
